scope: Every246 active player spell and every field in existing three-source infobox crosswalk, including no_source; also every import manifest destination and provenance. Does not assert complete independently observed game behavior or current public pages.

no_source includes not applicable fields and unavailable public evidence; absence is not agreement.
Raw infobox spellrange can describe attack footprint rather than selector; level can describe Wheel unlock rather than script minimum.
Full runtime AI/player/client execution qualification is separate.
Formula/area/condition/timing behavior is provenance-mapped in imports but not comprehensively cross-verified by this infobox comparator.

NOT_APPLICABLE describes whether a field exists for the exact imported execution; it never asserts an absent wiki value. The remaining missing category includes unknown semantics, not automatically defects.
